task: make the logging helper resolvable without the scripts/ dir on sys.path

inputs.helper_before: scripts/log_hygiene.py, imported as `from log_hygiene import ...` because the script's own dir is sys.path[0]

label.fix: moved the canonical helper to src/CORE/log_hygiene.py (stdlib-logging only, safe to import before CORE) and had all ten entry points resolve src/ from their own location -- sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'src')) -- then import CORE.log_hygiene; scripts/log_hygiene.py removed

task: prove the deep PDF check actually catches a truncated PDF

inputs.deep_branch: audit_parseable_files.py --deep opened each .pdf with pypdf and `except ImportError: pass`
inputs.environment: pypdf is installed in Python314 (graphify's env) but NOT in venv-314t, the interpreter the audit and the startup guard run under
